Alice Dobson, a 31-year-old West Yorkshire Police Community Support Officer, has been found guilty of leaking confidential operational information to a gang behind a horrific machete ambush in Bradford that left one man with his hand cut off.

She shared details of the police investigation with Rahees Khan, 43, one of five men convicted of conspiracy to murder.

On May 12, 2025, victims Zayad Khan and Usama Khan were rammed by three vehicles on Tickhill Street, Bradford, and ambushed with machetes. Usama suffered severe neck wounds, while Zayad’s left hand was severed and his right leg partially amputated. Surgeons later successfully reattached his hand.
